extension.description: Main media add-on for The Pirate, providing browsing and playback through your configured services and helpers.
extension.disclaimer: The author of this addon does not host any of the content which is found and has no affiliation with any of the content providers.
extension.news: Improved TV Guide loading. The loading screen stays up until every channel has program information, with a retry option if preparation fails. Includes the updated Home, TV Shows and Movies layouts in Pirate Skin 2.2.101.
